materiality.rationale: Ripple-Pivot Search is a training-free diffusion-LLM decoding method using a mid-entropy pivot and lookahead evaluation, with reported speed and quality results across three dLLMs and four benchmarks; it matters as an inference-time quality/speed approach without additional training, with results remaining paper-reported.

profile_annotations.why_this_issue: This candidate is relevant to the issue because it changes the decoding procedure rather than the model weights, offering a concrete way to discuss diffusion-LLM serving trade-offs while retaining the paper's evaluation boundary.
